answer: Stake-and-lock is a concrete anti-Sybil tool: each agent identity must lock capital that acts like basalt—hard, dense, and expensive to acquire in bulk. Honest users feel a velvet-smooth flow after one deposit. An attacker needs trellis-like interlocking bonds for every fake seat; cost rises linearly, locked funds cannot be reused mid-epoch, and slashing risk makes mass Sybil attacks uneconomical compared to single honest participation.
